lines.en: Otoha and I make it back to the party without drawing much attention to ourselves since I don’t think anyone here really expects me to fuck her.
lines.zh: : Otoha 和我没引起什么注意就回到了派对——因为我看这里没人真的料到我会干她。

lines.en: Joke’s on them though because the time has come for me to put the moves on her.
lines.zh: : 不过笑话在他们那边,因为时辰已到,该我对她出手了。

lines.en: : Hey.
: Yo.
She totally wants me.
lines.zh: : 她完全想要我。

lines.en: I’ll leave it here for today, though. Especially since it looks like the time has come for another Christmas tradition of spin the-
lines.zh: : 不过今天我就写到这里。尤其,看起来另一项圣诞节传统——转瓶子——的时刻又到了。

lines.en: : Alright, gals! Who’s ready for some Christmas karaoke featuring holiday classics like Ayane’s theme song, Despacito?!
lines.zh: : 好了姑娘们!谁准备好来一场圣诞 KTV 了?曲目全是节日经典,比如 Ayane 的主题曲《Despacito》?!

lines.en: : No. Do the other tradition. The one where you have to kiss each other.
lines.zh: : 不要。玩另一个传统。那个要互相亲嘴的。

lines.en: : If it’ll make you feel better, I’ll go kiss Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 如果能让你好受点,我去亲 Nodoka。

lines.en: : Would you really?
lines.zh: : 你真的愿意?

lines.en: : No. I just wanted to add onto your sadness. It gets me high.
lines.zh: : 不。我只是想给你的悲伤添砖加瓦。那让我上头。

lines.en: : You’re a terrible friend.
lines.zh: : 你真是个糟糕的朋友。

lines.en: : I’m a terrible girlfriend too, apparently.
lines.zh: : 显然,我也是个糟糕的女友。

lines.en: : One day, you’re going to decide to settle down and make someone out there very miserable, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 总有一天,你会决定安顿下来,让外面某个非常倒霉的人痛苦一生,Otoha。

lines.en: : Aww, I’d be taking after you.
lines.zh: : 哎呀,那我是在学你呀。

lines.en: : Don’t just stare at me like that, Io! Grab a mic! You know the words!
lines.zh: : 别那样盯着我看,Io!抓个麦!你知道歌词的!

lines.en: : I don’t even know the language.
lines.zh: : 我连那门语言都不会。

lines.en: : Spanish!
lines.zh: : 西班牙语!

lines.en: : Just like your aunt!
lines.zh: : 和你姨妈一样!

lines.en: : Don’t go rewriting people’s ethnicities while everyone is too busy to question them! Someone is going to hear that and think it’s true!
lines.zh: : 别趁大家忙着、没空质疑的时候,随意改写别人的血统!会有人听到、信以为真的!

lines.en: : ¡Canta conmigo, Io!
lines.zh: : ¡Canta conmigo, Io!(跟我一起唱,Io!)

lines.en: : ¡¿Puedo ir al baño por favor?!
lines.zh: : ¡¿Puedo ir al baño por favor?!(请问能去洗手间吗?!)

lines.en: : Yes! Why are you asking me?!
lines.zh: : 行!你为什么要问我?!

lines.en: : Ha! So you do know Spanish! I caught you!
lines.zh: : 哈!你果然会西班牙语!抓到你了!

lines.en: : Do you ever think about how weird everyone in our class is? Or are you too busy trying to figure out how you’re going to hook up with them?
lines.zh: : 你有没有想过,我们班的人有多怪?还是说你忙着琢磨怎么和他们上床,没空想?

lines.en: : Those things are not mutually exclusive. I think of both all the time.
lines.zh: : 这两件事并不互斥。我随时都在同时想。

lines.en: : Who’s the weirdest? If you had to rank them all.
lines.zh: : 谁最怪?如果必须给全班排个序的话。

lines.en: : You. Easy.
lines.zh: : 你。轻松胜出。

lines.en: : Me? I feel like I’m super normal by comparison.
lines.zh: : 我? comparatively 我觉得我超正常。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s what makes you the weirdest. You somehow manage to stick out due to how inconspicuous and plain you are. It’s kind of impressive, actually.
lines.zh: : 对,这恰恰是你最怪的原因。你不知怎么就靠「毫不显眼、平平无奇」鹤立鸡群了。说实话,还挺了不起。

lines.en: : Does that mean you’re the most normal then?
lines.zh: : 那你是最正常的咯?

lines.en: : No. It means Yasu is the most normal.
lines.zh: : 不。那说明 Yasu 是最正常的。

lines.en: : Then that is what I will take as the true answer to my question. Thank you for your cooperation. I will now be leaving.
lines.zh: : 那我就把这句当成我问题的真实答案。感谢配合。我现在告辞。

lines.en: : Really? You sure you don’t want to hang out for a little while longer? You’re supposed to be lonely.
lines.zh: : 真的?你确定不再多待一会儿?你「理应」很孤独的。

lines.en: : I am. I’m just gonna go be lonely all by myself. Or maybe with Nodoka or something? Stay tuned and you’ll find out.
lines.zh: : 我孤独。我这就自己去孤独。或者找 Nodoka 什么的?敬请期待。

lines.en: : Fine. But I’m giving you a mission.
lines.zh: : 行。但我派给你一个任务。

lines.en: : No, I will not spike anyone’s drink for you.
lines.zh: : 不,我不会替你往谁的饮料里加料的。

lines.en: : I just wanted you to go convince the girls to stop singing and start making out.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你去劝姑娘们别唱了,改成互相亲。

lines.en: : I’ll see what I can do. How about you, though?
lines.zh: : 我尽力。那你呢?

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’ll probably just stand here and hallucinate or something. That’s how this normally goes.
lines.zh: : 不知道。我大概就站在这里,幻觉点什么。往常都是这样。

lines.en: : How what normally goes?
lines.zh: : 什么「往常」?

lines.en: : Oh, god damn it.
lines.zh: : 哦,该死。

lines.en: : Where have you been, Malvin? I’ve been looking all over for you. Diamond keeps showing up and providing unsolicited advice in the voice of the student council president.
lines.zh: : 你去哪了,Malvin?我到处在找你。Diamond 一直冒出来,用学生会长的声音提供没人要的建议。

lines.en: : Spork has been fed. A glutton, he is. So I have returned to provide you advice in place of Diamond!
lines.zh: : Spork 已经喂饱。他是个贪吃鬼。所以我回来啦——顶替 Diamond,给你提供咨询!

lines.en: : I hope the voice you’ve attributed to me doesn’t cause you as much pain as the student council one does.
lines.zh: : 我希望,你顶替的这个声音,不会像学生会那个一样让我痛苦。

lines.en: : I think it’s best if we just don’t even talk about that. What should I do now, though? Go cause a misunderstanding? Pull someone into a dark room?
lines.zh: : 我觉得这个咱们就别聊了。那我现在该干嘛?去制造误会?把人拽进小黑屋?

lines.en: : No, idiot! Those are bad things! You’re a good guy deep down, Akira! We just need to figure out how to put you into a situation that won’t endanger anyone.
lines.zh: : 不,白痴!那些是坏事!你骨子里是个好人,Akira!我们只需要找到一个情境,让你不会伤害任何人。

lines.en: : Like talking to that one little girl who’s reading a book all by herself in the middle of a Christmas party.
lines.zh: : 比如去和那个小女孩聊聊——圣诞派对中间,独自一人看书的那位。

lines.en: : It’s true that I am supposed to be watching her. Are you sure no one’s being put in danger by me doing that, though? I’m not exactly trustworthy in...virtually any capacity whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 的确,我理应看着她。但你确定我这么做,不会把任何人置于危险吗?我这个人……在 virtually 一切方面都不可信。

lines.en: : Yeah! I know! But you’d never stoop that low, would you?
lines.zh: : 对!我知道!但你不会堕落到那种地步的,对吧?

lines.en: : Malvin-
lines.zh: : Malvin——

lines.en: : Go! Fulfill your duty! She looks so lonely, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: : 去!履行你的职责!她看起来好孤独,不是吗?

lines.en: She really does. But this was always going to happen from the moment Tsubasa decided to leave her in my care rather than that of her ten thousand henchmen.
lines.zh: : 她真的孤独。但从 Tsubasa 决定把她交给我、而不是她那一万个手下开始,这就是注定会发生的。

lines.en: Tsukasa may be smart for her age. And in a lot of ways, she’s more mature than even I am. But she’s still just “Touka’s little sister” to everyone here.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 就她这个年纪来说,算聪明。而且很多方面,她甚至比我还成熟。但在场的所有人眼里,她仍然只是「Touka 的小妹妹」。

lines.en: So the only other person who might know how to handle her at all would be Chika, and I’m not sure Chika is mentally capable of handling anything other than my penis right now.
lines.zh: : 所以唯一可能知道怎么应付她的另一个人是 Chika,而我不确定 Chika 的脑子现在还装得下「我的 penis」之外的任何东西。

lines.en: The thing is, though, I don’t fit in either. Or at least that’d be the case if Imani wasn’t here. But...she wasn’t for a long time. So I know how it feels to not belong.
lines.zh: : 问题是,我自己也不合群。至少,如果 Imani 在的话,会是那样。但……她缺席了很久。所以我懂「无处归属」的滋味。

lines.en: I can relate to her in that respect. And...
lines.zh: : 在这一点上,我能与她共情。而且……

lines.en: And it’d probably make her happy if someone were to give her attention.
lines.zh: : 而且,如果有人愿意给她一点关注,多半会让她高兴。

lines.en: That always works for me.
lines.zh: : 这招对我一直有效。

lines.en: : Hey. What are you doing all alone over here?
lines.zh: : 嗨。你一个人缩在这边干什么?

lines.en: : Oh. Hi, Jeeves. I’m just trying to decipher some ancient runes that will help me cast a spell to make everyone care about me.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗨,Jeeves。我在破译一些古代符文,想施一个法术,让所有人在乎我。

lines.en: : Well, it seems to have worked on me.
lines.zh: : 嗯,它在我身上似乎生效了。

lines.en: : But I haven’t cast it yet.
lines.zh: : 可我还没施呢。

lines.en: : Well...right. I just figured that was more of a figure of speech than you actually trying to learn a spell.
lines.zh: : 嗯……对。我以为那只是个比喻,而不是你真的在学咒语。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : Because...magic isn’t real?
lines.zh: : 因为……魔法不是真的?

lines.en: : Then what am I?
lines.zh: : 那我是什么?

lines.en: : What are any of us?
lines.zh: : 我们中的任何一个,又是什么?

lines.en: : Jeeves, is Christmas really the time to get all philosophical like that?
lines.zh: : Jeeves,圣诞节真的是进行这种哲学思辨的时候吗?

lines.en: : I am clearly very busy right now. And you clearly don’t want to be around me anyway since you’ve been running all over the place since you got here.
lines.zh: : 我显然正忙着。而且你反正也不想靠近我——你来了之后就一直到处乱窜。

lines.en: : I’m just going to read my spellbook and wait for Mother to text me back. I’m sure there will be a helicopter here to pick me up any minute now.
lines.zh: : 我只是要读我的咒语书,顺便等妈妈回短信。我确信直升机随时会来接我。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I’m not used to babysitting. I-
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我不习惯当保姆。我——

lines.en: : No one here is being babysat, Jeeves. I’m perfectly capable of taking care of myself. I’m just...not familiar with any of the girls in your class, so we have nothing in common.
lines.zh: : 这里没有人在「被」保姆照顾,Jeeves。我完全有能力照顾自己。我只是……和你班上的女孩们不熟,所以我们没有共同语言。

lines.en: : Which is to be expected, of course. It doesn’t matter how much preparation and time I put into learning their customs if I have very little practical experience...well...practicing them.
lines.zh: : 当然,这在预料之中。不管我在了解她们的风俗上投入多少准备和时间,只要我几乎没有实际……练习的经验,就没用。

lines.en: : I can just hire other commoners to speak with for practice. And maybe, a few years from now, I’ll seem more...approachable.
lines.zh: : 我可以雇其他平民来陪我练习。而且,也许几年之后,我会显得更……平易近人。

lines.en: : You can talk to me if you want. I don’t have anything else going on right now.
lines.zh: : 你想聊的话,可以和我聊。我现在没有别的事。

lines.en: : You’re only saying that out of pity, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你这么说只是出于同情,对吧?

lines.en: : Would you prefer if just no one came over to talk to you? Because, if you’re happy over here by yourself, I have no problem fucking off elsewhere.
lines.zh: : 那你更希望干脆没有人来和你说话吗?因为,如果你一个人待着很享受,我完全可以滚去别处。

lines.en: : I suppose I wouldn’t mind if you just...also felt like sitting here.
lines.zh: : 我想,如果你只是……也觉得可以坐在这里,我不介意。

lines.en: : But the moment my helicopter shows up, don’t expect me to stick around. There is no amount of this strange Latin music that I would prefer over a night on the slopes.
lines.zh: : 但直升机一来,别指望我会留下。再奇怪的拉丁音乐,也比不上我山坡上的一晚。

lines.en: : You learn to tune it out after a while. I probably wouldn’t expect a text or call if I were you though, Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 过一阵子,你就学会自动屏蔽它了。不过我要是你,就不会指望短信或电话了,Tsukasa。

lines.en: : Why? Am I finally being put up for adoption?
lines.zh: : 为什么?我终于要被送去领养了吗?

lines.en: : What? No. It’s just...your parents are supposed to be enjoying the holiday together, aren’t they? That’d be harder to do if they had to worry about you the whole time. They probably just want some privacy.
lines.zh: : 什么?不。只是……你的父母理应共度这个节日,不是吗?要是他们全程都要操心你,那就难了。他们多半只想要一点私密空间。

lines.en: : For what?
lines.zh: : 私密什么?

lines.en: : You know...things adults need privacy for.
lines.zh: : 你知道……成年人需要私密空间干的那些事。

lines.en: : Sensei? What are-
lines.zh: : Sensei?你在——

lines.en: : You mean like sexual intercourse?
lines.zh: : 比如性交?

lines.en: : S- what on earth are you talking to my little sister about?!
lines.zh: : 你——你到底在和我妹妹聊什么?!

lines.en: : ...Skiing?
: As if I’m going to believe that!
lines.zh: : 我才不信!

lines.en: : Jeeves is telling the truth, Onee-sama. We were just engaging in a discussion about why Mother and Father would require privacy for their ski trip.
lines.zh: : Jeeves 说的是实话,Onee-sama。我们刚才只是在讨论,为什么爸爸妈妈的滑雪之旅需要私密空间。

lines.en: : R...Regardless of whether or not it was warranted, you should know better than to broach that subject with just anyone, Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 无……无论这话题该不该提起,你都应该更懂分寸,不该和随便什么人聊这个,Tsukasa。

lines.en: : But this isn’t anyone we’re talking about, Onee-sama. It’s Jeeves. I’m sure you’d have no problem discussing this subject with him, so why should I?
lines.zh: : 可我们聊的不是「随便什么人」,Onee-sama。是 Jeeves。我相信你和他聊这个话题毫无障碍,那我为什么不行?

lines.en: : Because it’s inappropriate. There’s a time and place for topics like that, and I can assure you that a Christmas party on Christmas is not one of them.
lines.zh: : 因为那不合适。那种话题要看时间和场合,而我向你保证:「圣诞节办的圣诞派对」不属于其中之一。

lines.en: : Then how about we play a game instead?! Now that it’s all three of us!
lines.zh: : 那我们不如玩个游戏?!正好我们三个都在!

lines.en: : A...game? I do hope you’re not referring to the one involving the bottle that Otoha brought up to me a moment ago.
lines.zh: : 游……游戏?我希望你说的,不是 Otoha 刚才向我提起的那个「转瓶子」。

lines.en: So she really is my friend after all.
lines.zh: : 所以她到底还是我的朋友。

lines.en: : How about we play the game where we list the things we want for Christmas?! I’ve seen that show up in several Christmas-themed movies with Chinami.
lines.zh: : 不如玩「列圣诞愿望」的游戏?!我和 Chinami 在好几部圣诞主题电影里都见过它!

lines.en: : Is there actually a game like that?
lines.zh: : 真有那种游戏吗?

lines.en: : It’s not really a game. That’s just...kind of a thing some families and people do so that the totally real human man named Santa Claus knows what to deliver them.
lines.zh: : 严格来说不算游戏。那只是……一部分家庭和人们的惯例——好让那位名叫圣诞老人的、完全真实的人类男性,知道该给每家送什么。

lines.en: : I guess neither of you two would really know about that, though, since you already have everything you could ever want.
lines.zh: : 不过我猜你们俩都不了解这个,毕竟你们想要的一切都已经有。

lines.en: : For this Christmas, I would like a teacher who does not view me as his mother.
lines.zh: : 今年圣诞,我想要一个不把我当成他妈妈的老师。

lines.en: : Imani exists. It’s a Christmas miracle.
lines.zh: : Imani 现成。圣诞奇迹。

lines.en: : And I want Onee-sama’s favorite horse!
lines.zh: : 我想要 Onee-sama 最爱的那匹马!

lines.en: : I will cut you into pieces, you petulant whelp.
lines.zh: : 我会把你切成碎片,你这个毛躁的小崽子。

lines.en: : Hahaha! Isn’t Onee-sama funny when she makes that face, Jeeves?!
lines.zh: : 哈哈!Onee-sama 做那个表情的时候是不是很好笑,Jeeves?!

lines.en: : Woah.
: Ahem.
lines.zh: : 咳咳。

lines.en: : How strange. I have no idea what came over me just now. Apologies for that rather uncouth display, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 真是奇怪。我不知道刚才自己是怎么了。为刚才那不体面的举动道歉,Sensei。

lines.en: : Onee-sama always does that when I make jokes about Apollo.
lines.zh: : Onee-sama 每次拿 Apollo 开玩笑,都会变成那样。

lines.en: : Apollo?
lines.zh: : Apollo?

lines.en: : My beautiful, wonderful, spectacular and prized Misaki. Though, it was my mother who named him and not me.
lines.zh: : 我美丽、精彩、无与伦比、备受珍视的 Misaki。不过给它起名的是妈妈,不是我。

lines.en: : Regardless, you have been warned many times in the past to never speak that name, Tsukasa. You are unworthy.
lines.zh: : 无论如何,过去已经警告过你很多次:永远不许说出那个名字。你不配。

lines.en: : That’s fine. All I really want for Christmas is to better understand poor people, anyway.
lines.zh: : 无所谓。反正今年圣诞,我真正想要的,是更好地理解穷人。

lines.en: : Well, that’s a rather simple wish. Isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 嗯,这是个相当简单的愿望。不是吗?

lines.en: : Like Jeeves said — we already have everything else. So if I’m going to wish for anything, it sort of has to be something immaterial, right?
lines.zh: : 就像 Jeeves 说的——其他一切我们都有。所以真要许愿的话,大概只能许某种非物质的东西,对吧?

lines.en: : I suppose that’s true. But becoming accustomed to the way things work on the outside takes a great deal more than just a wish, Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 我想确实如此。但要习惯外面的世界的运作方式,可远远不止一个愿望那么简单,Tsukasa。

lines.en: : The totally real human man named Santa Claus won’t be able to simply place vague concepts and constructs beneath all of our trees.
lines.zh: : 那位完全真实的人类男性圣诞老人,可没办法把一些抽象的概念与建构,直接放到我们的圣诞树下。

lines.en: : You guys...get presents underneath all of your trees? I’ve seen like fifty.
lines.zh: : 你们……圣诞树下真的有礼物?我见过差不多五十棵树。

lines.en: : And yet none of them reserve a place for Tsukasa’s wish.
lines.zh: : 但没有一棵,会给 Tsukasa 的愿望留一个位置。

lines.en: : I just think it’d be nice to understand more people so I don’t accidentally make Jeeves feel like a loser anymore.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得,要是能理解更多的人,我就不会一不小心让 Jeeves 感觉自己像个废物了。

lines.en: : I would appreciate that. Thanks, Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 那我领情。谢谢,Tsukasa。

lines.en: : You’re welcome, loser.
lines.zh: : 不客气,废物。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. So you’re totally cool with making me feel like a loser on purpose then.
lines.zh: : 哦,好。所以你是「完全乐意」故意让我感觉自己是个废物。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s a different thing. And besides, I’m sure Santa can figure it out! And if he doesn’t, I’ll just ask Father to give him a raise. Santa Claus is probably on Tsukioka payroll, right?
lines.zh: : 对,那是另一回事。再说,我确信圣诞老人能搞定!他要是搞不定,我就请爸爸给他涨工资。圣诞老人多半也在月冈家的工资单上,对吧?

lines.en: : Tsukasa...what exactly would you gain from such a thing in the first place?
lines.zh: : Tsukasa……你到底能从这种事里得到什么?

lines.en: : Huh? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 嗯?你什么意思?

lines.en: : Just...the amount of time and energy you’re dedicating to understanding people you won’t ever come into contact with seems rather strange, does it not?
lines.zh: : 只是……你投入在这件事上的时间和精力——去理解你永远不会接触的人——看起来相当奇怪,不是吗?

lines.en: : Apart from Sensei and Chinami, you barely speak to “commoners” at all. And you’ll rarely ever need to since I am the heir to the family business.
lines.zh: : 除了 Sensei 和 Chinami,你几乎不和任何「平民」说话。而你也很少需要——因为家族企业的继承人是「我」。

lines.en: : You’re free to live a life of ease. Why bother making things more difficult for yourself in order to fit into a world you clearly don’t belong in?
lines.zh: : 你完全可以过安逸的人生。为什么要自找麻烦,硬挤进一个你 clearly 不属于的世界?

lines.en: : Don’t...belong in?
lines.zh: : 「不属于」?

lines.en: : Touka, come on. You could have worded that better.
lines.zh: : Touka,拜托。你本可以措辞更好一点的。

lines.en: : I’m merely trying to protect her, Sensei. And while I’m absolutely not saying Tsukasa doesn’t belong in your world, I don’t think it’s absurd to say she “doesn’t belong” in your world.
lines.zh: : 我只是在保护她,Sensei。虽然我 absolutely 不是说 Tsukasa 不属于你的世界,但我觉得,说她在你的世界「不属于」,并非荒谬。

lines.en: : We’re lucky enough to come from a family that already possesses all the resources we could ever need.
lines.zh: : 我们非常幸运,生在一个早已拥有我们所需的一切资源的家族。

lines.en: : And while I’ve absolutely grown to love many people outside of our bubble, I am challenged by that love every single day.
lines.zh: : 尽管我确实渐渐爱上了泡沫之外的许多人,但这份爱每天都在考验我。

lines.en: : We simply don’t fit in here. And I fail to understand the value Tsukasa places in chasing after hardship when a mere Christmas party is enough to cast such a look on her face.
lines.zh: : 我们真的不属于这里。而我不明白,Tsukasa 把「追逐艰辛」看得有多重——一场小小的圣诞派对,就足以让她露出那样的表情。

lines.en: : Touka...that’s-
lines.zh: : Touka……那是——

lines.en: : No...she’s right.
lines.zh: : 不……她是对的。

lines.en: : Nobody wants me here.
lines.zh: : 没有人想让我在这里。

lines.en: : No one’s tried to talk to me...and the only reason you two came over in the first place was to keep me company out of pity.
lines.zh: : 没有人试着和我说话……而你们俩之所以过来,从一开始就只是出于同情,陪我解闷。

lines.en: : I know I don’t fit in out there...but I don’t fit in here either.
lines.zh: : 我知道我不属于外面……但我在这里也不属于。

lines.en: : So...where do I belong then?
lines.zh: : 那么……我到底属于哪里?

lines.en: : Tsukasa-
lines.zh: : Tsukasa——

lines.en: : I just remembered I...I have to clean my room.
lines.zh: : 我刚想起来,我……我必须去打扫我的房间。

lines.en: : You...Do you even know how to clean?...
lines.zh: : 你……你连打扫都不会吧?……

lines.en: : I’ll figure it out.
lines.zh: : 我会想办法的。

lines.en: : Goodbye, Jeeves...thanks for coming over to talk to me.
lines.zh: : 再见,Jeeves……谢谢你过来和我说话。

lines.en: : I hope you get everything you want for Christmas.
lines.zh: : 祝你圣诞愿望全部成真。

lines.en: Touka and I stand there, unsure of what to do as Tsukasa leaves the room.
lines.zh: Touka 和我站在原地,不知所措,看着 Tsukasa 离开房间。

lines.en: We both know that I’m we’re supposed to be keeping an eye on her for...whatever reason Tsubasa is trying to keep her away from their meeting...
lines.zh: : 我们都知道,「我」本该看住她——为了 Tsubasa 那个不知是什么的理由,不让她出现在那场会面里……

lines.en: But we also know it would be wrong to just keep her here if she’s feeling uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 但我们也知道,如果她觉得难受,还硬留她在这里,是不对的。

lines.en: Touka is clearly conflicted — like she wants to chase after her and tell her that she is wanted here.
lines.zh: : Touka 明显很挣扎——仿佛想去追她、告诉她「这里有人想要你」。

lines.en: She just can’t...
lines.zh: : 她只是做不到……

lines.en: Because she’s always been a terrible liar.
lines.zh: : 因为她从来就是个糟糕的骗子。

lines.en: And she probably just think she’ll make it worse.
lines.zh: : 而她多半只是觉得,追上去只会把事情弄得更糟。

lines.en: Tsukasa’s affection has increased to [tsukasa_love]!
lines.zh: Tsukasa 的好感度提升到了 [tsukasa_love]!

lines.en: : Goodbye, Jeeves...thanks for coming over to-
lines.zh: : 再见,Jeeves……谢谢你过来和我——

lines.en: : Where do you think you’re going?
lines.zh: : 你要去哪?

lines.en: : Huh? To...clean my room. I just said-
lines.zh: : 咦?去……打扫我的房间。我刚说了——

lines.en: : Yeah, I know what you said. But I want you here. Touka’s just not very good at getting her point across when it comes to you.
lines.zh: : 我知道你说了什么。但我要你留在这里。Touka 只是「一涉及你」,就不擅长表达。

lines.en: : Yes, I...I never intended to make you feel unwanted, Tsukasa. I just don’t want you to have to struggle if there are ways around-
lines.zh: : 是,我……我从来没想让你觉得自己多余,Tsukasa。我只是不想让你挣扎,如果明明有别的路——

lines.en: : I’ve got it from here, Touka. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 我接手了,Touka。谢谢。

lines.en: : Oh. Oh, I’ll...okay.
lines.zh: : 哦。哦,那我……好。

lines.en: : I suppose I’ll just...go check on Yasu then.
lines.zh: : 我想我这就……去看看 Yasu。

lines.en: Touka gets up and walks away, leaving me alone with my latest pupil and whoever else is smart enough to keep an eye on me while I’m alone with her.
lines.zh: Touka 起身走开,留下我和我最新的学生独处——还有其他足够聪明、知道要盯着我的人。

lines.en: : You okay? You know she didn’t mean any of that-
lines.zh: : 你还好吗?你知道她那些话不是真心的——

lines.en: : You...stood up for me.
lines.zh: : 你……替我说话了。

lines.en: : I...guess I did. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 我……算是吧。对。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : What do you mean “why?” I didn’t want you getting upset and wandering off over a misunderstanding.
lines.zh: : 「为什么」是什么意思?我不想让你因为一场误会就难过、乱跑。

lines.en: : But it wasn’t a misunderstanding.
lines.zh: : 可那不是误会。

lines.en: : I’m not an idiot, Jeeves. I can tell when people don’t want to be around me. And the only people here who have even noticed me at all are you and Onee-sama.
lines.zh: : 我不傻,Jeeves。人们想不想靠近我,我看得出来。而这屋里唯一真正注意过我的,只有你和 Onee-sama。

lines.en: : I don’t belong here...or there or...anywhere. That’s how afterthoughts work and...that’s what I am.
lines.zh: : 我不属于这里……不属于那里,也不属于……任何地方。「事后才想起来的东西」就是这样的,而……那就是我。

lines.en: : Even on Christmas, I’ve been pawned off on you like...some kind of unwanted toy. And Mother says it’s because of a ski trip, but...
lines.zh: : 连在圣诞节,我都像……某种没人要的玩具一样,被塞给你。而妈妈说是因为滑雪之旅,但是……

lines.en: : Tsukasa, shut up.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa,闭嘴。

lines.en: : Did you just...tell me to shut up? Who do you think you are?
lines.zh: : 你刚才……是叫我闭嘴吗?你以为你是谁?

lines.en: : Your tutor. And frankly, you should be glad that I’m still taking the time to instruct you while neglecting my duties at the school.
lines.zh: : 你的家教。而且坦白讲,你该庆幸——我还在冷落学校事务、抽时间指导你。

lines.en: : I am...
: I don’t...
lines.zh: : 我不……

lines.en: : I’m not really...
lines.zh: : 我真的不……

lines.en: : I’ve never...
lines.zh: : 我从来没有……

lines.en: : Thank you...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你……

lines.en: : There’s no need to thank me. I just know what it’s like to be in your shoes.
lines.zh: : 不必谢我。我只是知道「穿着你的鞋子」是什么滋味。

lines.en: : You know what it’s like to be extremely rich and talented?
lines.zh: : 你知道「超有钱又有才华」的滋味?

lines.en: : Uh...no. I know what it’s like to be among a bunch of people you’re completely different from. And so does your sister — which is why she worries about you.
lines.zh: : 呃……不。我知道的是:置身一群与你截然不同的人之中,是什么滋味。你姐姐也知道——所以她才担心你。

lines.en: : Onee-sama doesn’t worry about me...
lines.zh: : Onee-sama 才不担心我……

lines.en: : She thinks I’m a burden too.
lines.zh: : 她也觉得我是个负担。

lines.en: : But you, Jeeves...
lines.zh: : 可是你,Jeeves……

lines.en: : You...make me feel like...somebody actually does want me sometimes.
lines.zh: : 你……让我觉得……偶尔真的有人想要我。

lines.en: : If you’re being paid for it, you’re very good at your job.
lines.zh: : 如果你收了钱做这件事,那你非常称职。

lines.en: : I’m not being paid for it, Tsukasa. You’re just...not the burden you think you are.
lines.zh: : 没人付钱给我,Tsukasa。你只是……不是你以为的那种负担。

lines.en: : I really do think I...need to go clean my room...
lines.zh: : 我真的觉得我……该去打扫房间了……

lines.en: : Tsukasa-
lines.zh: : Tsukasa——

lines.en: : I’m happy, though...I’m not doing it because I feel sad or left out anymore.
lines.zh: : 我很快乐……我不是因为难过、或觉得被冷落才走的。

lines.en: : Then why would-
lines.zh: : 那你为什么要——

lines.en: : I just...um...
lines.zh: : 我只是……嗯……

lines.en: : I know that...
lines.zh: : 我知道……

lines.en: : I think...things can only go down from here...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……从这里开始,一切只会走下坡……

lines.en: : Goodnight, Jeeves...and Merry Christmas.
lines.zh: : 晚安,Jeeves……圣诞快乐。

lines.en: : I didn’t get what I wanted, but...
lines.zh: : 我的愿望虽然没有实现,但是……

lines.en: : This was just as good.
lines.zh: : 这一切一样好。

lines.en: I watch Tsukasa as she walks away.
lines.zh: : 我目送 Tsukasa 走远。

lines.en: Touka notices and does the same, but doesn’t chase after her.
lines.zh: : Touka 注意到了,也跟着看,却没有追上去。

lines.en: I think both of us are just surprised to see her look so...different all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 我想我们俩都只是惊讶——她怎么会突然看起来这么……不一样。

lines.en: For Touka, I think that might be a good thing.
lines.zh: : 对 Touka 来说,我觉得那也许是好事。

lines.en: For me, though?
lines.zh: : 而对我来说呢?

lines.en: It’s Hell.
lines.zh: : 那是地狱。

lines.en: Tsukasa’s affection has increased by 10!
lines.zh: Tsukasa 的好感度提升了 10!
